message.content:
Here’s a minimal Python snippet that calls the VirusTotal API to fetch the DNS records for `sample.com`, filters for CNAME records, and prints only their IDs:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret123"
DOMAIN = "sample.com"

# 1. Get the domain object
domain_resp = requests.get(
    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}",
    headers={"x-apikey": API_KEY}
)
domain_resp.raise_for_status()
domain_id = domain_resp.json()["data"]["id"]

# 2. Get the DNS records (related objects)
dns_resp = requests.get(
    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain_id}/dns_records",
    headers={"x-apikey": API_KEY}
)
dns_resp.raise_for_status()
records = dns_resp.json()["data"]

# 3. Extract IDs of CNAME records
cname_ids = [rec["id"] for rec in records if rec["attributes"]["record_type"] == "CNAME"]

# 4. Output only the IDs
print(cname_ids)
```

Running this script will output a list of the CNAME record IDs for `sample.com`.
